checks.note: reconcileMarketplaceTiers computes entitledTier from the detached findAll() snapshot (sub.getTier()/getStatus()) and never re-reads the payment row in the per-row transaction, so a persistCoachTierUpgrade/revoke committing after the batch load is overwritten by syncMarketplaceTier, which locks only coach_profiles and writes unconditionally. A @Version on CoachSubscription would not help — the sweep reads the projection fresh in-transaction, so the stale-tier save carries a current version; cadence only affects how long the wrong tier persists.

Within this file the finding reads syncPaymentMethodToSubscriptions correctly: the superseded-card guard (stripeCustomerRepository.findById at the method top) is a plain unlocked read, nothing here serialises two syncs for one user, and the per-attempt UUID idempotency keys don't close the A/B interleaving. But the finding's own verification caveat turns on PaymentMethodSyncOutboxHandler / PaymentMethodSyncOutboxSupport's claim mechanism (per-user serial, in-order processing would refute it), and that code is not provided.
